newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica money market shortage above 9.0 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica money market shortage above 9.0 bln rand.

text.p: The Reserve Bank said the South African money market shortage rose to 9.377 billion rand on Thursday from 9.071 billion rand on Wednesday.
On Friday morning, three-month NCD rates were quoted steady at between 17.00 percent and 17.10 percent offered, while the 90-day BA rate was also unchanged at between 16.40 and 16.65 percent.
Banks had raised their three-month NCD rates and the 90-day BA rate slightly during the course of Thursday.
